extra_sections.title: Job Objective
items: Results-driven business leader with over 10 years of experience, specializing in Category & Business Development, Operations, P&L Management, Product Marketing, Project Management, and now targeting similar roles.

extra_sections.title: Profile Summary
items: Possess extensive experience in leading business strategies, optimizing P&L, and guiding cross-functional teams with over 10 years of experience, contributing to organizational success.
Currently heading the FMCG and Grocery business vertical at Ninjacart, India's leading Agri-commerce company.

Prior to Ninjacart, led revenue and growth at Unacademy, India’s leading Ed-tech platform. Attained a 30% YoY growth in revenue with a 20% EBITDA, delivering positive cash flow in the challenging Ed-Tech landscape.
Proficient in utilizing tools like Microsoft Office Suite, Figma, Tableau, AppsFlyer, Google Analytics, Google Ads, Amplitude, SQL, Jira, Salesforce, and GPT engines.
Deep understanding of Cost Reduction, Performance Marketing, Product Management, UI/UX, Program Management, Lead Generation, Customer Lifecycle Management, and driving Growth.
Cultivated strong relationships with key brands and sellers to ensure sustainable business growth across geographies.
Established core backend functions from scratch, built a robust supplier base, and collaborated with engineering and design teams for successful product launches.
Experienced in reducing CAC, and optimize marketing spends.
Led cross-functional teams of over 250 members across layers.
Developing and implementing revenue growth strategies, market trend analysis, and customer lifecycle management to drive business expansion and profitability across diverse industries.

extra_sections.title: Entrepreneurial Ventures
items: Dazzilo: Conceptualized and developed an AI powered influencer marketing platform and secured three term sheets. However, did not proceed due to unfavorable terms.

Valarlife: Launched this spirulina and moringa health supplement online store to promote healthy living. Revenue Generated: $200 K Funding: $100 K
Fraternitee: B2B apparel manufacturing for schools, colleges, startups, corporates, NGOs, etc. Revenue Generated: $250 K

posting.title: Head of Category – Grocery & FMCG
must_have: 8-12 years in category management, buying or merchandising in grocery, FMCG, quick-commerce or e-commerce
Has owned a category P&L of meaningful size
Comfortable with margin, pricing and inventory math
Experience negotiating with national FMCG brands and distributors
Hands-on with data: SQL or strong analyst partnership, dashboards, pricing benchmarks
Has built and run a team of 10+
Has worked closely with product/engineering on internal tools
nice_to_have: Experience launching a new city or region
company_language: hand in hand with product and supply chain
joint business plans with top FMCG brands
red_flags: Very broad scope for one role: P&L, assortment, pricing, supplier terms, inventory and team leadership across 40+ stores and three cities
Wide experience band (8-12 years) with no clear sense of what matters most
"Thrives in speed" is vague and undefined
Requires both deep category expertise and hands-on SQL/analytics with no stated expectation of which is primary

matches.requirement: 8-12 years in category management, buying or merchandising in grocery, FMCG, quick-commerce or e-commerce
matches.evidence: Senior Manager, Category Management (Ninjacart, Apr’18–Mar’21); Director, FMCG and Grocery (Ninjacart, Aug’24–Present)
matches.suggestion: State the category tenure explicitly, e.g. '7+ years in category management across agri-commerce, grocery and FMCG at Ninjacart and Fashinza.' The 10 total years include 3 as a software engineer, so don't claim 10 in category.

matches.requirement: Has owned a category P&L of meaningful size
matches.evidence: Managed P&L for key categories contributing 60% of revenue, driving 5x growth in daily volumes within 100 days.
matches.suggestion: Use Zepto's phrase 'owned the Grocery & FMCG P&L'. Add absolute revenue or GMV for the Ninjacart FMCG and Grocery vertical if you can share it.

matches.requirement: Comfortable with margin, pricing and inventory math
matches.evidence: End-to-end category management, product selection, market intelligence, pricing strategies, inventory optimization, P&L management, vendor negotiations, and retail strategy implementation.
matches.suggestion: Add one quantified margin or inventory outcome, such as margin improvement, wastage reduction or inventory days, to show the math.

matches.requirement: Experience negotiating with national FMCG brands and distributors
matches.evidence: vendor negotiations; Cultivated strong relationships with key brands and sellers to ensure sustainable business growth across geographies.
matches.suggestion: Name the national FMCG brands and distributors you negotiated with, and mention joint business plans or trade terms. The résumé only says 'vendor negotiations' and 'key brands'.

matches.requirement: Hands-on with data: SQL or strong analyst partnership, dashboards, pricing benchmarks
matches.evidence: conducting daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs; Tableau, Amplitude, SQL, Google Analytics
matches.suggestion: Lead with 'daily competitive benchmarking' to match Zepto's wording, and mention the dashboards you built or used in Tableau.

matches.requirement: Has built and run a team of 10+
matches.evidence: Led cross-functional teams of over 250 members across layers.
matches.suggestion: Clarify how many were direct reports and how many were category or buying team members, since 250 across layers is broad.

matches.requirement: Has worked closely with product/engineering on internal tools
matches.evidence: Worked closely with the tech and engineering teams and product managed the entire development and deployment of the seller and buyer facing applications.
matches.suggestion: Say 'worked hand in hand with product and engineering'. Mention any internal tools such as pricing, inventory or procurement tools, since the example given is buyer- and seller-facing apps.

matches.evidence: driving 5x growth in daily volumes within 100 days; Drove online revenue market share from 8% to a commanding 55% in just 18 months
matches.suggestion: Frame these as evidence of speed, e.g. 'scaled 5x in 100 days in a fast-moving perishable market'. Don't just claim the trait.
Already based in Bengaluru, so no change is needed.
No quick-commerce or dark-store experience is shown. Mention adjacent fast-turn perishable supply chain work at Ninjacart, but don't claim dark-store experience.

matches.requirement: Experience launching a new city or region
matches.evidence: Led P&L optimization and market intelligence for 30+ cities
matches.suggestion: If you were involved in opening or scaling any of those cities, say so explicitly, e.g. 'launched X cities'. Otherwise describe it only as multi-city operations.

matches.evidence: B.E. Computer Science, CEG, Anna University; Software Engineer, Accenture (Sep’14–Aug’17)
matches.suggestion: Highlight the CS degree and 3 years as a software engineer as a differentiator when working with product and tech.

rewrite.referral_note: Hi, I'm applying for the Head of Category, Grocery & FMCG role at Zepto in Bengaluru and wondered if you'd be open to a referral. I currently lead FMCG and Grocery at Ninjacart, where I manage the category P&L for key categories contributing 60% of revenue and drove 5x daily volume growth within 100 days. I also run daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs, which I think lines up with your daily competitive benchmarking. Would you be willing to refer me? I'm happy to share more detail.
rewrite.fit_line: Your strongest matches are category P&L ownership, daily pricing benchmarks and product work with engineering in Bengaluru, but expect questions on the absence of dark-store or quick-commerce experience, the limited grocery category tenure (about five years at Ninjacart), and the lack of direct evidence for national FMCG brand negotiations and hands-on SQL.

problems.claim: Director of FMCG and Grocery at Ninjacart, owning category management, P&L, pricing, inventory and vendor negotiations across 30+ cities.
problems.reason: The original ties the 30+ cities scope to the earlier Ninjacart Chennai role (Apr'18 to Mar'21: 'P&L optimization and market intelligence for 30+ cities'). The current-role bullets do not mention 30+ cities, so attaching it to the current role misattributes the scope.

problems.claim: Pricing and benchmarking: ran market intelligence and daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs in 30+ cities
problems.reason: The original states daily price benchmarking across 75+ SKUs and, separately, P&L optimization and market intelligence for 30+ cities. It does not say the benchmarking covered 30+ cities; the two facts are merged into a combined claim the source does not make.
